basic_details.job_title: National Authority CAMPA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 19 Accountant/Auditor, Under Secretary and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (National Authority- CAMPA) has announced 19 vacancies for Under Secretary, Senior Account Officer, Section Officer, Technical Officer (Forestry), Assistant Section Officer, Accountant/Auditor, PPS, Sr. PS, PA, and Legal Assistant/Law Officer posts on a deputation basis for five years. Candidates can apply by email, sending the complete application through proper channel along with required documents so that it reaches latest by 25 November 2026. content_sections.heading: National Authority- CAMPA Under Secretary Job Description
content_sections.text: Under Secretary: Excellent note-taking/drafting skills; experience of dealing with Court Cases, Parliament matters, Vigilance, RTI, etc.; minimum 5-10 years' experience of handling budget and accounts matters in Ministries/Departments of the Government of India; Output-Outcome Monitoring Framework including submission of the same to the CEO; matters related to Parliamentary Standing Committee including preparation of Background Note and Action Taken Replies; submission of replies to RTI applications; looking after works related to establishment, finance, General Administration, framing of rules and regulations, and regulatory matters. Senior Account Officer: Pre-audit, passing of bills, and preparation of Accounts. Section Officer: Establishment, administration, finance and accounts, and regulatory matters. Technical Officer (Forestry): Examination of the Annual Plan of Operations/Policy matters of the State Authorities, monitoring of different activities, formulate proposals for new schemes. Assistant Section Officer: Initial examination of the proposal relating to establishment finance and regulatory matters, and maintenance of a record of the Section. Accountant/Auditor: Preparation of bills and pre-auditing calculations and deduction of dues, taxes, and depositing them with the concerned department. PPS: Providing all types of secretarial assistance to Members like other CSSS Officers. Sr. PS / PA: Providing all type of secretarial assistance to Senior Officers. Legal Assistant/Law Officer: Keeping all legal records ready and preliminary examination of cases from legal angle, submission of draft Petition/ Rejoinders etc.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Up-to-date ACR Dossiers or attested photocopies of annual confidential reports for the last five years Vigilance Clearance Report Statement showing minor/major penalties imposed, if any Integrity Certificate (Annexure-3) Filled application proforma (Annexure-A) along with Vigilance Clearance Certificate (Annexure-1) and No Penalty Certificate (Annexure-2)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for appointment on deputation is made from suitable candidates who fulfill the eligibility conditions through proper channel, subject to availability of ACR dossiers, vigilance clearance, and integrity certification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced in National Authority- CAMPA recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 19 vacancies have been announced across various posts on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for National Authority- CAMPA recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to forward applications via email is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for appointment on deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the email address to submit the application?
faq.answer: Applications must be forwarded on the email ID [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for the Under Secretary post?
faq.answer: The Under Secretary post is in Pay Level-11 with a pay range of Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700.

faq.question: Q6. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Officers under the Central Government, State Government, Public Sector Undertakings, or Autonomous Organisations holding analogous posts on regular basis or possessing specified years of regular service in designated pay levels are eligible.

faq.question: Q7. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose up-to-date ACR dossiers for the last 5 years, vigilance clearance report, statement of minor/major penalties, integrity certificate, and the application proforma forwarded through proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. What is the tenure of deputation?
faq.answer: The appointment is made on a deputation basis for a period of five years.
